scope_limits: Only the printed universal unit-length2 conjunct is disproved. The source imposes no indecomposability condition; the concrete category is the decomposable pointwise product of three genuine finite-dimensional complex-vector-space categories.
No claim is made about unspecified representation-dimension-table, global-dimension or local-unit uniqueness assertions. No numerical dimension formula is assigned as a hypothesis.

The pointwise product is explicitly distinguished from the EGNO matrix-category example. EGNO is used only for standard definitions; all category, subobject, simple-class, projectivity and composition-length bridges used in the proof are Lean-proved.

The transported native saturated unit chain has explicit bottom/top endpoints and proved actual cover relations. Native Jordan-Hoelder in the actual modular Subobject lattice establishes length3 for every complete series, so a defined chain length is never used as an unproved composition-length invariant.
